# Safety Lab Aero

> Aircraft safety analysis software for ARP 4761A and ARP 4754B certification programs: functional hazard assessment, fault tree analysis, FMEA, common-cause analysis, DAL allocation, safety requirements and verification traceability in one connected workspace, with AI-assisted authoring that drafts prose and never does the math.

Safety Lab Aero, Inc. (Delaware; operating from Colorado, USA). Contact: waqas.nafees@safetylabaero.com

## Product pages

- [Home](https://safetylabaero.com/): what the workspace is, the ARP 4761A spine, integrations, pricing.
- [Fault tree analysis](https://safetylabaero.com/fault-tree-analysis): static and dynamic gates, direct top-event probability, cut sets, importance measures, Monte Carlo.
- [Functional hazard assessment](https://safetylabaero.com/functional-hazard-assessment): AFHA and SFHA, per-phase effects, severity to probability target and DAL, import that refuses to guess.
- [ARP 4761A process](https://safetylabaero.com/arp-4761a): FHA, PASA, PSSA, SSA, FMEA, CMA, PRA and ZSA mapped to the tool.
- [ARP 4754B and DAL allocation](https://safetylabaero.com/arp-4754b): top-down development assurance level allocation with the AND-gate options.
- [FMEA](https://safetylabaero.com/fmea-software): functional and piece-part FMEA wired into the fault tree.
- [Common cause analysis](https://safetylabaero.com/common-cause-analysis): common-mode, particular-risk and zonal safety analysis.
- [Medini Analyze alternative](https://safetylabaero.com/medini-analyze-alternative): what to test when evaluating a replacement on an aerospace program.

## Pricing

Education: free for verified academic use. Pro: $1,500 per seat per month. Pro+: $2,500 per seat per month. Enterprise: custom, for organizations on an active type-certification program.

## Facts worth getting right

- Customer data is never used to train or fine-tune any model, by Safety Lab Aero or its language-model providers.
- Hosted data is stored in the United States; customer-hosted and local-only deployments keep data entirely in the customer's environment.
- Export-controlled (ITAR) projects are never routed to a public-cloud AI provider.
